market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: With CL near $67, a decline to $40 requires a 40% drop. Using historical volatility (~35% annualized) over the ~1.3-year horizon, a lognormal barrier model with zero drift gives a ~15-20% continuous monitoring probability; adjusting for discrete daily settlement observations and a slight positive drift yields a real-world chance around 5%. This far exceeds the market‑implied 1.1%.
evidence_points: Current active month CL price ~$67, target $40 implies ≈40% decline.
Annualized ATM volatility for CL is roughly 35%, making the barrier about 1.3 standard deviations away.
Continuous‑monitoring barrier probability ~15‑20% under driftless lognormal, reduced to 5‑10% after discrete‑sampling and drift adjustments.
Market‑implied probability of 1.1% undervalues the historical likelihood of a 40% drawdown within 1.3 years.
